title: Claims Schedule Footnote: the Share Promptness Carries — Travel Protection Plans
content:
A cancellation claim rated on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is taken at a share which promptness carries, and that share is read from the ledger of the linked vacation package, one of the Vacation Package Products: whether it carries the line that gave the value back, and how long before the journey was to begin that line stands.

Where the ledger of the linked package carries the line that gave the value back and the journey was given up more than a fortnight before it was to begin — more than 14 whole calendar days before the first day of the journey insured — the share promptness carries is the whole of the amount, 100 per cent.

Where the ledger of the linked package carries the line that gave the value back and the journey was given up a fortnight or less before it was to begin — 14 whole calendar days or fewer — the share promptness carries is 90 per cent.

Where neither holds, the share promptness carries is 75 per cent.

## Both sides of the threshold

| Line that gave the value back, on the linked package's ledger | Whole calendar days from that line to the first day of the journey insured | Share promptness carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stands | More than 14 | 100 per cent |
| Stands | 14 or fewer | 90 per cent |
| Does not stand | — | 75 per cent |

At 15 days the first case applies and the share is 100 per cent. At exactly 14 days the second applies and the share is 90 per cent, the boundary day itself falling on the later side. At 3 days the second still applies.

Where the linked package's ledger carries no line that gave the value back at all, neither of the first two is reached and the share is 75 per cent, however early or late the journey was given up.

Hypothetically, on an amount of 4000.00 USD before the share is taken, the three cases give 4000.00 USD, 3600.00 USD and 3000.00 USD respectively.
